column1: # Complete native hover / hotkey descriptions, Linux DF 53.16.
# Source inventory: data/extracted/tooltip-sources.tsv (all 609 initializer calls), plus the
# dynamic widget, weather and RAW building strings documented in both tables.
# Whole sentences only; no English-wrap fragments and no empty deletion rules.
# Report popup button: constructed by the widget, outside the toolbar initializer.
# This is a hover document, not an ordinary UI message or separate wrapped rows.
Toggle auto-pause on new report.
column2: 切换收到新报告时是否自动暂停。

column1: Set digging orders.
column2: 设置挖掘命令。

column1: Finish setting dig orders.
column2: 结束挖掘命令设置。

column1: Dig a regular hallway or room. Assign a miner to the work detail if necessary. The miner requires a pick.
column2: 挖掘普通走廊或房间。必要时将矿工分配到相应劳动分组。矿工需要一把镐。

column1: Designate constructed walls, floors, and other constructed tiles to be removed by miners. This also designates all stairwells and ramps.
column2: 指定由矿工拆除建造的墙壁、地板及其他人工建造的地格。此操作也可指定移除所有楼梯和斜坡。

column1: Dig a stairwell on this level, going up or down. Your selection must span multiple elevations. Click on a tile, change elevations, and click again.
column2: 挖掘向上或向下的楼梯。选区必须跨越多个高度层。先点击一个地格，切换高度，再次点击。

column1: Dig a ramp on this level, going up.
column2: 在本层挖掘通往上一层的斜坡。

column1: Dig a channel, making a ramp on the level below.
column2: 挖掘沟道，在下一层形成斜坡。

column1: Hold left button to draw.
column2: 按住鼠标左键涂画。

column1: Left click to choose corners of a rectangle.
column2: 点击鼠标左键选择矩形的角点。

column1: Dig every tile selected.
column2: 挖掘选中的全部地格。

column1: Dig only ore and gems selected, and automine any ore and gems of the same type which are uncovered.
column2: 仅挖掘选中的矿石和宝石，并自动挖掘由此发现的同类矿石和宝石。

column1: Dig only ore and gems selected.
column2: 仅挖掘选中的矿石和宝石。

column1: Dig only gems selected.
column2: 仅挖掘选中的宝石。

column1: Selected tiles are very high priority.
column2: 将选中地格设为很高优先级。

column1: Selected tiles are high priority.
column2: 将选中地格设为高优先级。

column1: Selected tiles are high-medium priority.
column2: 将选中地格设为中高优先级。

column1: Selected tiles are medium priority. [DEFAULT]
column2: 将选中地格设为中等优先级。【默认】

column1: Selected tiles are medium-low priority.
column2: 将选中地格设为中低优先级。

column1: Selected tiles are low priority.
column2: 将选中地格设为低优先级。

column1: Selected tiles are very low priority.
column2: 将选中地格设为很低优先级。

column1: Change to standard dig mode.
column2: 切换到普通挖掘模式。

column1: Change to blueprint-only mode.
column2: 切换到仅绘制蓝图模式。

column1: Change blueprints to standard selections.
column2: 将蓝图转为普通指定区域。

column1: Change standard selections to blueprints.
column2: 将普通指定区域转为蓝图。

column1: Show advanced options.
column2: 显示高级选项。

column1: Hide advanced options.
column2: 隐藏高级选项。

column1: Set tree chopping orders.
column2: 设置树木砍伐命令。

column1: Set tree chopping orders. Select the base of the tree so that the woodcutter can reach it. Assign a woodcutter to the work detail if necessary. The woodcutter requires an axe.
column2: 设置树木砍伐命令。选择树干底部，使樵夫能够到达。必要时将樵夫分配到相应劳动分组。樵夫需要一把斧头。

column1: Finish setting tree chopping orders.
column2: 结束树木砍伐命令设置。

column1: Change to standard chop mode.
column2: 切换到普通砍伐模式。

column1: Set plant gathering orders.
column2: 设置植物采集命令。

column1: Set plant gathering orders. Some plants require fruit or other growths to be present.
column2: 设置植物采集命令。某些植物需要长有果实或其他生长物才能采集。

column1: Finish setting plant gathering orders.
column2: 结束植物采集命令设置。

column1: Change to standard gather mode.
column2: 切换到普通采集模式。

column1: Set wall smoothing, engraving, track carving, and fortification orders.
column2: 设置墙壁打磨、雕刻、轨道雕凿和城防垛口开凿命令。

column1: Smooth a rough wall to make it more pleasing to your citizens. This also prepares the wall for engraving or fortification.
column2: 打磨粗糙墙壁，使居民更为喜爱。打磨后也可进行雕刻或开凿城防垛口。

column1: Engrave artwork into a smooth wall.
column2: 在平滑墙壁上雕刻艺术作品。

column1: Carve a track in a stone floor. Tracks are used by minecarts with routes set in the hauling menu.
column2: 在石地板上雕凿轨道。矿车沿轨道行驶，路线在搬运菜单中设置。

column1: Carve a gap in a smooth wall to allow your archers to fire upon invaders.
column2: 在平滑墙壁上开凿射击孔，让弓弩手向入侵者射击。

column1: Finish setting wall orders.
column2: 结束墙壁作业命令设置。

column1: Change to standard orders mode.
column2: 切换到普通命令模式。

column1: Designate items for dumping and melting, claim forbidden items and buildings, and set item visibility.
column2: 指定倾倒或熔化物品、解除物品和建筑的禁用状态，以及设置物品可见性。

column1: Finish setting item/building designations.
column2: 结束物品和建筑指定操作。

column1: Claim a forbidden item or building so it will be used by your citizens.
column2: 解除物品或建筑的禁用状态，使居民能够使用。

column1: Forbid your citizens from using an item or building.
column2: 禁止居民使用某件物品或建筑。

column1: Designate an item for dumping in a dumping zone.
column2: 指定将物品运到物品倾倒区。

column1: Remove dumping designations.
column2: 移除倾倒标记。

column1: Designate an item for melting at any smelter.
column2: 指定在任意熔炉中熔化物品。

column1: Remove melting designations.
column2: 移除熔化标记。

column1: Remove hidden designations.
column2: 移除隐藏标记。

column1: Hide an item or building from your view. Citizens will still use it.
column2: 隐藏物品或建筑。居民仍会使用它。

column1: Set high and low traffic areas.
column2: 设置高通行和低通行区域。

column1: Finish setting traffic areas.
column2: 结束通行区域设置。

column1: Set a high traffic area. Use this in wide central passages.
column2: 设置高通行区域。适用于宽阔的主要通道。

column1: Set a normal traffic area, the default state.
column2: 设置普通通行区域，这是默认状态。

column1: Set a low traffic area. Citizens will look for better routes.
column2: 设置低通行区域。居民会寻找更好的路线。

column1: Set a restricted traffic area. Citizens will look hard for better routes. They will still use the area if other routes do not exist or are too long.
column2: 设置限制通行区域。居民会尽力寻找更好的路线，但没有其他路线或绕路过远时，仍会通过这里。

column1: Set the exact weight in steps of a traffic type.
column2: 设置此通行类型的具体步数权重。

column1: Remove mining, woodcutting, plant gathering, and smoothing orders.
column2: 移除挖矿、伐木、植物采集和打磨命令。

column1: Finish removing mining etc. orders.
column2: 结束移除挖矿等命令。

column1: Place structures and work areas that require construction materials.
column2: 放置需要建造材料的建筑和工作区域。

column1: Finish placing structures.
column2: 结束放置建筑。

column1: Place stockpiles for item storage.
column2: 放置用于存储物品的储物堆。

column1: Finish placing stockpiles.
column2: 结束放置储物堆。

column1: Start painting a new stockpile. Once the tiles are chosen, you'll be able to set the details.
column2: 开始涂画新的储物堆。选好地格后即可设置详细信息。

column1: Remove the stockpile being painted permanently. Also removes existing zones!
column2: 永久移除正在涂画的储物堆。也会移除已有区域！

column1: Repaint this stockpile.
column2: 重新涂画此储物堆。

column1: Erase a portion of this stockpile.
column2: 擦除此储物堆的一部分。

column1: Remove this stockpile permanently.
column2: 永久移除此储物堆。

column1: Toggle whether the stockpile can take items from anywhere or only from specific workshops and stockpiles.
column2: 切换此储物堆是从任意地点取物，还是仅从指定工坊和储物堆取物。

column1: Set from which workshops and stockpiles this stockpile gives and takes items.
column2: 设置此储物堆向哪些工坊和储物堆供货，以及从哪些地方取货。

column1: Set how many barrerls, bins, and wheelbarrows this stockpile can use.
column2: 设置此储物堆可以使用的圆桶、储物箱和手推车数量。

column1: Place zones to establish meeting areas, pastures, and more.
column2: 划定区域，设置集会区、畜栏／牧场等。

column1: Finish placing zones.
column2: 结束放置区域。

column1: Start painting a new zone. Once the tiles are chosen, you'll be able to set the details.
column2: 开始涂画新的区域。选好地格后即可设置详细信息。

column1: Go to the previous zone overlapping the tile you clicked.
column2: 切换到与所点击地格重叠的上一个区域。

column1: Go to the next zone overlapping the tile you clicked.
column2: 切换到与所点击地格重叠的下一个区域。

column1: Repaint this zone.
column2: 重新涂画此区域。

column1: Erase a portion of this zone.
column2: 擦除此区域的一部分。

column1: Suspend activities in this zone. Does not remove the zone.
column2: 暂停此区域内的活动，但不移除区域。

column1: Remove this zone permanently.
column2: 永久移除此区域。

column1: Gather fruit in trees in and just above this zone. Requires a stepladder.
column2: 采集此区域内及其正上方树木上的果实。需要折梯。

column1: Gather fruit and vegetables from shrubs in this zone.
column2: 采集此区域灌木上的果实和蔬菜。

column1: Gather fallen fruit in this zone.
column2: 采集此区域内掉落的果实。

column1: Select animals to be placed in this pasture zone. They will stay after being led here.
column2: 选择安置在此畜栏／牧场的动物。动物被牵到这里后会留在区域内。

column1: Designate this zone as the top of a pit. Citizens will not fill the pit below with water.
column2: 将此区域设为坑洞模式。居民不会向下方的坑洞灌水。

column1: Designate this zone as the top of a pond. Citizens will bring buckets of water if the pond below isn't filled.
column2: 将此区域设为池塘模式。如果下方池塘尚未灌满，居民会提桶运水。

column1: Select animals to be dropped into the pit or pond below this zone. Animals will not feel obligated to stay if they can find a way out.
column2: 选择要投入此区域下方坑洞或池塘的动物。只要能找到出路，动物就可能离开。

column1: Assign a new or existing location to this zone. Locations are groups of zones and rooms with a larger purpose, like a tavern, a temple, a library, or a craft guildhall.
column2: 为此区域指定新地点或已有地点。地点由多个区域和房间组成，承担共同用途，例如酒馆、神殿、图书馆或工匠行会大厅。

column1: Set details for the assigned location.
column2: 设置所指定地点的详细信息。

column1: Select this option and any unassigned deceased citizens will be buried here automatically.
column2: 选中后，尚未分配墓地的已故居民会自动安葬在这里。

column1: Select this option and any unassigned deceased pets will be buried here automatically.
column2: 选中后，尚未分配墓地的已故宠物会自动安葬在这里。

column1: Choose which squads will use this barracks.
column2: 选择使用此兵营的小队。

column1: Remove the zone being painted permanently. Also removes existing zones!
column2: 永久移除正在涂画的区域。也会移除已有区域！

column1: Your citizens will drink at a water source zone or gather water using buckets for various tasks. This is useful if you don't have a functioning well and you want to control exactly where the tasks take place.
column2: 居民会在取水区饮水，或用桶取水以完成各项任务。如果没有可用的水井，又想指定取水地点，就可以设置取水区。

column1: Citizens assigned to the fishing work detail will fish in this zone if it exists. Otherwise, they will fish everywhere.
column2: 若设有捕鱼区，被分配到捕鱼劳动分组的居民会在这里捕鱼；否则会在各处捕鱼。

column1: Plant gathering zones are used in locations where plants will be gathered frequently. Use the gather designation otherwise.
column2: 植物采集区适合需要经常采集植物的地方。其他地方可直接指定采集。

column1: Items designated for dumping will be tossed into open air spaces included in this zone. If no open air tiles are included, they will dump the items on the floor.
column2: 标记为倾倒的物品会被投入物品倾倒区内的悬空地格。若没有悬空地格，则会放在地板上。

column1: Certain livestock need to graze on grass. Assign these animals to a pasture zone. No fencing is needed.
column2: 某些牲畜需要吃草。可划定畜栏／牧场，将这些动物分配到有草的区域，无需建造围栏。

column1: Animals assigned to pit/pond zones are dumped in the pit, but will leave the zone afterward if possible. If the pit is designated as a pond, your citizens will attempt to fill it with water using buckets.
column2: 分配到坑洞／池塘的动物会被投入下方的坑内，但只要找到出路就可能离开。若设为池塘模式，居民会尝试用桶向下方灌水。

column1: Your citizens will fill sand bags at this zone if a sandy floor or sandy wall is included. This task is initiated manually at the glass furnace.
column2: 采沙区若包含沙质地面或墙壁，居民就能在此装沙入袋。采沙任务须在玻璃窑手动发起。

column1: Your citizens will collect clay at this zone if a clay floor or clay wall is included. This task is initiated manually at the kiln.
column2: 黏土采集区若包含黏土地面或墙壁，居民就能在此采集黏土。采集任务须在黏土窑手动发起。

column1: This important zone is where your citizens will gather to socialize. Crucially, the meeting area is where locations such as taverns, temples, hospitals, and the like are established.
column2: 居民会聚集在这个重要区域进行社交。更重要的是，酒馆、神殿、医院等地点都在集会区建立。

column1: Animals that are capable of being trained receive their training at this zone once they have been assigned a trainer from the Pets/Livestock menu. Generally, a piece of meat is required.
column2: 可训练的动物会在驯兽区接受训练，须先在“宠物／牲畜”菜单中分配训练员。通常需要一块肉。

column1: Your citizens will sleep in bedrooms. It should include a bed! Try to enclose it with walls and/or doors. Do not overlap with other rooms.
column2: 居民会在卧室睡觉。卧室应放置床！尽量用墙壁和门围起来，不要与其他房间重叠。

column1: Your citizens will eat at this zone. When not assigned to a particular citizen, citizens without their own dining hall will eat here. Tables and adjacent chairs should be included.
column2: 居民会在此区域用餐。若未指定给某位居民，没有私人餐厅的居民就会在此用餐。应放置餐桌及相邻的椅子。

column1: An office or study is required for certain official tasks, such as approving work orders and bookkeeping. A chair or throne is required for these functions.
column2: 批准工单、记账等公务需要办公室或书房。必须放置椅子才能执行这些职务。

column1: Your archers can train in this zone if there is an archery target included.
column2: 此区域若包含射箭靶，弓弩手就可以在这里训练。

column1: Squads should be assigned to a barracks. The squad can be set to train, sleep, and store equipment there.
column2: 应将小队分配到兵营。可设置小队在此训练、睡觉和存放装备。

column1: Dormitories should include multiple beds and will not belong to a particular citizen.
column2: 公共宿舍应放置多张床，不属于某位特定居民。

column1: Prisoners convicted in the Justice menu can be incarcerated at a chain or metal cage in the dungeon zone.
column2: 在“司法”菜单中定罪的囚犯，可以用监牢内的锁链或金属笼关押。

column1: Deceased citizens and pets can be laid to rest in a tomb. It should include a coffin, casket, or sarcophagus.
column2: 已故居民和宠物可以安葬在墓地中。墓地应放置棺材、灵柩或石棺。

column1: Establish burrows to organize work and living spaces in larger fortresses.
column2: 建立活动区，以组织大型要塞内的工作和生活空间。

column1: Finish establishing burrows.
column2: 结束建立活动区。

column1: Remove the burrow being painted permanently. Also removes existing burrows!
column2: 永久移除正在涂画的活动区。也会移除已有活动区！

column1: Repaint this burrow.
column2: 重新涂画此活动区。

column1: Erase a portion of this burrow.
column2: 擦除此活动区的一部分。

column1: Remove this burrow permanently.
column2: 永久移除此活动区。

column1: Recenter on this burrow.
column2: 将视图重新居中到此活动区。

column1: Toggle whether workshops can source materials from outside the burrow.
column2: 切换工坊是否可以从活动区外获取材料。

column1: Suspend this burrow. Assigned citizens will not respect burrow restrictions while a burrow is suspended, but all tasks within the burrow will still function.
column2: 暂停此活动区。暂停期间，分配到这里的居民不受活动区限制，但活动区内的各项任务仍可正常进行。

column1: Set hauling routes for minecarts.
column2: 设置矿车运输路线。

column1: Finish setting hauling routes.
column2: 结束运输路线设置。

column1: Add a stop to this route. Minecarts will move between stops when conditions are satisfied.
column2: 为此路线添加站点。满足条件时，矿车会在站点之间移动。

column1: Assign a minecart to this route. Only one vehicle can operate on each route.
column2: 为此路线分配矿车。每条路线只能使用一辆车。

column1: Name this route.
column2: 为此路线命名。

column1: Remove this route.
column2: 移除此路线。

column1: Set the items desired by the minecart at this stop. Items must be in a linked stockpile.
column2: 设置矿车在此站点需要的物品。物品必须位于已连接的储物堆中。

column1: Link a stockpile to this stop. Citizens will haul items to and from the minecart as you specify. Items for the minecart must be specified using the desired items button to the left.
column2: 将储物堆连接到此站点。居民会按你的设置为矿车装卸物品。矿车需要的物品须通过左侧的“所需物品”按钮指定。

column1: Set conditions for the minecart to move on to the next stop.
column2: 设置矿车前往下一站的条件。

column1: Name this stop.
column2: 为此站点命名。

column1: Remove this stop.
column2: 移除此站点。

column1: The assigned vehicle is at this stop.
column2: 已分配的车辆停在此站点。

column1: The assigned vehicle is moving toward this stop.
column2: 已分配的车辆正在前往此站点。

column1: The assigned vehicle wants to be at this stop but is not currently there. A worker may be bringing it, or it may be stranded.
column2: 已分配的车辆应在此站点，但目前不在这里。可能正由工人运来，也可能被困住了。

column1: Open the citizen information menu.
column2: 打开居民信息菜单。

column1: Open the task information menu.
column2: 打开任务信息菜单。

column1: Open the place information menu.
column2: 打开地点信息菜单。

column1: Open the labor menu.
column2: 打开劳动菜单。

column1: Open the work orders menu.
column2: 打开工单菜单。

column1: Open the nobles and administrators menu.
column2: 打开贵族和管理员菜单。

column1: Open the objects menu.
column2: 打开物品菜单。

column1: Open the squad sidebar.
column2: 打开小队侧栏。

column1: Open the world screen.
column2: 打开世界界面。

column1: Open the justice menu.
column2: 打开司法菜单。

column1: Convict a suspect for this crime.
column2: 将嫌疑人判定为此案的罪犯。

column1: Interrogate suspects for wrongdoing.
column2: 审讯涉嫌违法行为的人。

column1: Toggle whether the stockpile allows plant and animal-based objects, regardless of other settings.
column2: 切换此储物堆是否允许存放动植物制品，不受其他设置影响。

column1: Toggle whether the stockpile allows non-plant-and-animal-based objects, regardless of other settings.
column2: 切换此储物堆是否允许存放非动植物制品，不受其他设置影响。

column1: Toggle whether goods banned by export mandates are listed.
column2: 切换是否列出被出口禁令禁止交易的货物。

column1: Sort by distance from the depot.
column2: 按距离贸易站的远近排序。

column1: Sort by value.
column2: 按价值排序。

column1: (De)select all currently displayed items
column2: 全选或取消选择当前显示的全部物品。

column1: Leave menu and recenter the view on the time.
column2: 离开菜单，并将视图重新居中到此物品。

column1: Leave menu and open the item's sheet.
column2: 离开菜单，并打开此物品的详情页。

column1: Toggle the forbidden status of the item. Citizens will not use forbidden items or buildings.
column2: 切换物品的禁用状态。居民不会使用被禁用的物品或建筑。

column1: Toggle the dump status of the item. Items are dumped in dumping zones.
column2: 切换物品的倾倒状态。物品会被运到物品倾倒区。

column2: 大多数改变地形的建造选项都在这里，包括墙壁、地板、桥梁、斜坡和楼梯等。

column1: More complicated buildings from wells to powered machine components to levers and floodgates are found here.
column2: 这里包含较复杂的建筑，如水井、动力机械部件、控制杆和闸门。

column1: Cages, ropes, and animal traps are found here. Cages can be used in cage traps or to transport large animals. Metal cages and chains are also used by the justice system.
column2: 这里包含笼子、绳索和动物陷阱。笼子可用于笼陷阱或运输大型动物，金属笼和锁链也用于司法系统。

column1: Various mechanical traps can be found here. The pressure plate is also found here, which has applications beyond traps.
column2: 这里包含各种机械陷阱，也包含用途不局限于陷阱的压力板。

column1: Archery targets, siege weapons, and some ornamental display items can be found in this category.
column2: 此类别包含射箭靶、攻城武器和一些装饰展示物品。

column1: This crucial building is where all trading will be done. Pack animals from distant civilizations will need to access this building from the edge of the map. Later, wagons will need a clear 3-wide path to the depot.
column2: 所有交易都在这座关键建筑进行。远方文明的驮畜需要从地图边缘抵达这里。之后到来的货车还需要一条畅通的三格宽道路通往贸易站。

column1: Used to make lye, potash, and milk of lime. Construction requires blocks, barrel, and a bucket.
column2: 用于制作碱液、草碱和石灰乳。建造需要砖块、圆桶和水桶。

column1: Make crossbows here from wood or bone. The metalsmith's forge can be used for metal crossbows and metal bolts, and the crafts workshop is used to make other bolts.
column2: 在这里用木材或骨头制作弩。金属弩和金属弩箭可在金属锻造坊制作，其他弩箭则在工艺品工坊制作。

column1: Make beds and various furniture here, as well as bins, barrels, and more.
column2: 在这里制作床、各种家具、储物箱和圆桶等。

column1: Make crafts for trade and your own citizens here, as well as a variety of tools, armor, and bolts.
column2: 在这里制作供交易和居民使用的工艺品，以及各种工具、护甲和弩箭。

column1: Cut rough gems here to increase their value, and improve the value of other objects by encrusting them with cut gems.
column2: 在这里切割宝石原石以提高价值，也可将切割宝石镶嵌到其他物品上以提升其价值。

column1: Forge weapons and armor here, as well as most other metal objects from furniture to trap components. Magma below the forge will power tasks. You are responsible for placing the forge above the magma, but no other fuel is required.
column2: 在这里锻造武器、护甲，以及从家具到陷阱部件等大多数金属物品。下方岩浆会为作业供能。你需要将岩浆锻造坊建在岩浆上方，但无需其他燃料。

column1: Make mechanisms here which are used to make levers, pressure plates, and gears. You can also use mechanisms to link levers and pressure plates to other machinery.
column2: 在这里制作机械装置，用于制作控制杆、压力板和齿轮。机械装置也可将控制杆和压力板连接到其他机械。

column1: Forge weapons and armor here, as well as most other metal objects from furniture to trap components. These tasks require fuel.
column2: 在这里锻造武器、护甲，以及从家具到陷阱部件等大多数金属物品。这些任务需要燃料。

column1: Here you can make parts for ballistae and catapults. This workshop is also the place where ballista ammo is assembled.
column2: 在这里制作弩炮和投石机的部件，也可在此工坊组装弩炮弹药。

column1: Make stone furniture here, as well as blocks which are used in constructions.
column2: 在这里制作石制家具，以及用于建造的砖块。

column1: Use tallow (rendered fat) or oil here with lye to make soap.
column2: 在这里用脂油（熬制的脂肪）或油与碱液制作肥皂。

column1: A useful workshop for pressing liquids from various sources. Some plants might need to be milled first before they can be used. Empty jugs are required to store the liquid products.
column2: 一个用于从各种原料中压榨液体的实用工坊。有些植物可能需要先研磨才能使用。制成的液体需要用空壶储存。

column1: Use leather tanned at the tanner's shop here to make clothing and tools, such as bags and waterskins.
column2: 在这里使用制革工坊鞣制的皮革，制作衣物及袋子、水囊等工具。

column1: Here you can turn thread into cloth, whether it is thread from the farmer's workshop or spider silk gathered underground.
column2: 在这里将线织成布，既可使用农夫工坊生产的线，也可使用地下采集的蛛丝。

column1: Make cloth into clothing and tools here, such as bags and ropes.
column2: 在这里用布制作衣物及袋子、绳索等工具。

column1: Use dyes here to color thread and cloth. Requires a barrel and bucket for construction.
column2: 在这里使用染料为线和布染色。建造需要圆桶和水桶。

column1: Brew alcohol from plants, fruit, or honey.
column2: 用植物、果实或蜂蜜酿酒。

column1: Slaughter livestock here in order to obtain meat, hides, bones, and other animal products.
column2: 在这里屠宰牲畜，获取肉、兽皮、骨头及其他动物产品。

column1: Make leather from animal hides here. You can also make parchment using milk of lime and a hide.
column2: 在这里将兽皮制成皮革，也可用石灰乳和兽皮制作羊皮纸。

column1: Process raw fish into edible food here. Raw fish will not be eaten.
column2: 在这里将生鱼加工成可食用的食物。未经加工的生鱼不会被食用。

column1: Cook meals here. You can also render fat into tallow.
column2: 在这里烹饪饭菜，也可将脂肪熬制成脂油。

column1: Process plants and work with livestock here. Milk and shear animals, make cheese, and spin thread.
column2: 在这里加工植物和照料牲畜：挤奶、剪毛、制作奶酪和纺线。

column1: Make sugar, flour, and various useful slurries here. Tasks are completed very slowly compared to the powered millstone.
column2: 在这里制作糖、面粉和各种有用的浆料。与有动力的机械石磨相比，加工速度很慢。

column1: Capture and train small animals here. Requires animal traps.
column2: 在这里捕捉和训练小动物。需要动物陷阱。

column1: Make sugar, flour, and various useful slurries here. Powered version of the quern. Must be hooked to a windmill or water wheel to function.
column2: 在这里制作糖、面粉和各种有用的浆料。这是手推磨的动力版本，必须连接风车或水车才能运作。

column1: You can make a variety of objects using three different types of glass. You can also collect sand in bags from a task originating here, if you have a sand collection zone. Glassmaking requires fuel.
column2: 可用三种不同的玻璃制作各种物品。如果设有采沙区，也可从这里发起用袋子收集沙子的任务。制作玻璃需要燃料。

column1: Bake clay objects here, as well as a few other useful materials. Clay can also be collected here if you have a clay collection zone. All tasks require fuel aside from clay collection.
column2: 在这里烧制黏土物品及一些其他有用材料。如果设有黏土采集区，也可从这里发起采集黏土的任务。除采集黏土外，所有任务都需要燃料。

column1: You can make a variety of objects using three different types of glass. You can also collect sand in bags from a task originating here, if you have a sand collection zone. Magma below the furnace will power tasks. You are responsible for placing the furnace above the magma, but no other fuel is required.
column2: 可用三种不同的玻璃制作各种物品。如果设有采沙区，也可从这里发起用袋子收集沙子的任务。炉下方的岩浆会为作业供能。你需要将炉建在岩浆上方，但无需其他燃料。

column1: Bake clay objects here, as well as a few other useful materials. Clay can also be collected here if you have a clay collection zone. Magma below the kiln will power tasks. You are responsible for placing the kiln above the magma, but no other fuel is required.
column2: 在这里烧制黏土物品及一些其他有用材料。如果设有黏土采集区，也可从这里发起采集黏土的任务。窑下方的岩浆会为作业供能。你需要将窑建在岩浆上方，但无需其他燃料。

column1: Make metal bars from ore here. Can also refine coal into usable fuel or make alloys. Magma below the smelter will power tasks. You are responsible for placing the smelter above the magma, but no other fuel is required.
column2: 在这里将矿石熔炼成金属锭，也可将煤加工成可用燃料或制造合金。熔炉下方的岩浆会为作业供能。你需要将熔炉建在岩浆上方，但无需其他燃料。

column1: Make metal bars from ore here. Can also refine coal into usable fuel or make alloys. All tasks require fuel.
column2: 在这里将矿石熔炼成金属锭，也可将煤加工成可用燃料或制造合金。所有任务都需要燃料。

column1: Make charcoal and ash from wood here. Does not require fuel.
column2: 在这里用木材烧制木炭和灰。不需要额外燃料。

column1: Plant crops at the farmplot. You will need seeds or spawn and must select crops by season. Crops can be fertilized with potash. Soil is richer deeper underground.
column2: 在农田种植作物。需要种子或菌种，并须按季节选择作物。可用草碱施肥。地下深处的土壤更加肥沃。

column1: When placed, a female bird will claim the box and start laying eggs, if one is available.
column2: 放置巢箱后，如果有可用的雌鸟，它会占用巢箱并开始产卵。

column1: Keep a colony of insects at your hives. A wild colony must be collected after the hive is placed, or a colony can be split from an existing hive colony.
column2: 在蜂箱中饲养昆虫群体。放置蜂箱后，需要采集野生群体，或从现有蜂箱群体中分群。

column1: Your citizens need a comfortable place to sleep. A bed object must be made at the carpenter's shop before it can be placed.
column2: 居民需要舒适的睡眠场所。须先在木匠工坊制作床，才能放置。

column1: Chairs are required for offices to function, and a chair next to a table is the preferred dining arrangement. A chair/throne object must be made before it can be placed.
column2: 办公室需要椅子才能运作，用餐时最好将椅子放在餐桌旁。须先制作椅子，才能放置。

column1: Tables are required for dining. A chair should be placed adjacent to the table. A table object must be made before it can be placed.
column2: 用餐需要餐桌，旁边应放置椅子。须先制作餐桌，才能放置。

column1: Chests and coffers are used in personal bedrooms for storing non-clothing objects. They are also used in some zone-based locations like taverns, hospitals, and libraries for storing useful materials. A box object must be made before it can be placed.
column2: 箱子和石箱用于在私人卧室存放非衣物物品，也用于酒馆、医院和图书馆等区域型地点，储存所需物资。须先制作箱子，才能放置。

column1: Cabinets are used in personal bedrooms for storing clothing objects. A cabinet object must be made before it can be placed.
column2: 橱柜用于在私人卧室存放衣物。须先制作橱柜，才能放置。

column1: The dead are buried in coffins. Coffins must be placed in their own tomb zone in order to work. A coffin object must be made before it can be placed.
column2: 死者安葬于棺材中。棺材必须置于各自独立的墓地内才能使用。须先制作棺材，才能放置。

column1: Citizens that cannot be buried properly can still be memorialized on slabs. Slabs are created and engraved at the stoneworker's shop.
column2: 无法妥善安葬的居民仍可通过纪念石板悼念。石板在石匠工坊制作和刻写。

column1: Statues can be used to decorate your fortress and add value to your rooms. A statue object must be made at an appropriate workshop first.
column2: 雕像可以装饰要塞并提高房间价值。须先在相应工坊制作雕像。

column1: Certain injuries such as overlapping fractures require advanced medical contraptions like the traction bench for treatment. A traction bench object must be made before it can be placed.
column2: 重叠骨折等伤势需要牵引台之类的高级医疗器具治疗。须先制作牵引台，才能放置。

column1: Codices and scrolls in your library can be stored in bookcases. A bookcase object must be made before it can be placed.
column2: 图书馆中的书册和卷轴可以存放在书柜里。须先制作书柜，才能放置。

column1: Your most valuable objects can be placed for display in rooms to increase their value and to entertain passing citizens. A pedestal or display case must be made before it can be placed.
column2: 可在房间中展示最珍贵的物品，提高房间价值，并供路过的居民欣赏。须先制作基座或展示柜，才能放置。

column1: These ornamental objects increase the value of rooms in which they are placed. An offering place object must be made before it can be placed.
column2: 这些装饰物品可提高所在房间的价值。须先制作供奉处，才能放置。

column1: Large instruments must be placed in taverns or temples before they will be used. These instruments must be assembled at a workshop first.
column2: 大型乐器须放置在酒馆或神殿中才会被使用。必须先在工坊组装好这些乐器。

column1: Doors can be used along with walls to enclose rooms, which is especially important when placing multiple zones at once. Doors can also be forbidden or attached to levers to control movement in the fort.
column2: 门可配合墙壁围出房间，同时设置多个区域时尤为重要。也可禁用门或将门连接到控制杆，以控制要塞内的通行。

column1: Hatches can be placed at the tops of stairwells or above ramps to control movement in the fort when they are forbidden or attached to levers.
column2: 舱盖可放在楼梯井顶部或斜坡上方。禁用舱盖或将其连接到控制杆，即可控制要塞内的通行。

column1: Bridges can be used to span open spaces or placed above water or magma. Bridges can be connected to levers and raised to block access.
column2: 桥梁可跨越空隙，也可建在水或岩浆上方。桥梁可连接到控制杆，升起后阻断通路。

column1: Paved roads use less materials than constructed floors and can be used to stop plants from growing over wagon trails.
column2: 铺砌道路比建造地板耗材更少，还能防止植物长满货车通道。

column1: Dirt roads do not require materials, but the dirt road may quickly be overgrown by plants.
column2: 土路不需要材料，但可能很快被植物覆盖。

column1: Blocks creatures but allows the passage of fluids and items. Can be built on any floor. Grates unlike bars have a quality and enhance the value of rooms. Grates can be connected to levers.
column2: 阻挡生物，但允许液体和物品通过。可建在任何地板上。格栅与栅条不同，具有品质，可以提高房间价值。格栅可连接到控制杆。

column1: Blocks creatures but allows the passage of fluids and items. Can be built over empty spaces, stairs, ramps, or above liquids. Grates unlike bars have a quality and enhance the value of rooms. Grates can be connected to levers.
column2: 阻挡生物，但允许液体和物品通过。可建在空隙、楼梯、斜坡或液体上方。格栅与栅条不同，具有品质，可以提高房间价值。格栅可连接到控制杆。

column1: Blocks creatures but allows the passage of fluids and items. Can be built on any floor. Bars unlike grates do not have a quality and so do not enhance the value of rooms significantly. Bars can be connected to levers.
column2: 阻挡生物，但允许液体和物品通过。可建在任何地板上。栅条与格栅不同，没有品质，因此不会显著提高房间价值。栅条可连接到控制杆。

column1: Blocks creatures but allows the passage of fluids and items. Can be built over empty spaces, stairs, ramps, or above liquids. Bars unlike grates do not have a quality and so do not enhance the value of rooms significantly. Bars can be connected to levers.
column2: 阻挡生物，但允许液体和物品通过。可建在空隙、楼梯、斜坡或液体上方。栅条与格栅不同，没有品质，因此不会显著提高房间价值。栅条可连接到控制杆。

column1: This ornamental construction can enhance the value of rooms. A window object must be made at a glass furnace before it can be placed.
column2: 这种装饰建筑可提高房间价值。须先在玻璃窑制作窗户，才能放置。

column1: This ornamental construction can enhance the value of rooms. Three cut gem objects must be made at a jeweler's shop before it can be placed.
column2: 这种装饰建筑可提高房间价值。须先在珠宝匠工坊制作三颗切割宝石，才能放置。

column1: Supports will stop cave-ins in the rare event you completely detach a piece of your fortress. Otherwise, they are ornamental.
column2: 如果你挖断了要塞某部分的全部连接，支柱可防止其塌方。这种情况很少见，其余时候支柱主要用于装饰。

column1: You can build walls aboveground, in caverns, or in spaces you have mined out in order to block the passage of creatures, objects, and fluids. Requires boulder, block, or wood.
column2: 可在地表、洞窟或已经挖空的地方建造墙壁，阻挡生物、物品和液体通过。需要巨石、砖块或木材。

column1: You can build reinforced walls aboveground, in caverns, or in spaces you have mined out in order to block the passage of creatures, objects, and fluids. Requires two boulder, block, or wood, and metal bars. Provides some resistance to invaders.
column2: 可在地表、洞窟或已经挖空的地方建造加固墙壁，阻挡生物、物品和液体通过。需要两份巨石、砖块或木材，以及金属锭。能在一定程度上抵御入侵者。

column1: You can place floors for functional reasons or to enhance the appearance of the fortress. Requires boulder, block, or wood.
column2: 可因实际用途或美化要塞而铺设地板。需要巨石、砖块或木材。

column1: You can build a ramp next to a wall to provide access to the floor above. The space above the ramp must also be empty. Requires boulder, block, or wood.
column2: 可在墙边建造通往上一层的斜坡。斜坡上方也必须留空。需要巨石、砖块或木材。

column1: You can build staircases to connect different elevations. Staircases must span at least two elevations. Requires boulder, block, or wood.
column2: 可建造楼梯连接不同高度层。楼梯必须跨越至少两层。需要巨石、砖块或木材。

column1: Fortifications block creature movement but allow projectiles through. Soldiers near fortifications are reasonably safe from incoming projectiles. Requires boulder, block, or wood.
column2: 城防垛口阻挡生物移动，但允许投射物穿过。靠近垛口的士兵能较好地抵御来袭投射物。需要巨石、砖块或木材。

column1: Use minecart tracks in conjunction with the hauling menu.
column2: 矿车轨道须配合搬运菜单使用。

column1: Place the well in an open space above water to provide a relatively safe area for your citizens to draw water. Requires mechanisms, blocks, a chain or rope, and a bucket.
column2: 将水井建在水面上方的空格，为居民提供相对安全的取水地点。需要机械装置、砖块、锁链或绳索，以及水桶。

column1: Use floodgates to control the flow of fluids between spaces in your fortress. Must be attached to a lever or pressure plate to function. Requires a floodgate object to be built before it can be placed.
column2: 使用闸门控制要塞不同空间之间的液体流动。必须连接到控制杆或压力板才能运作。须先制作闸门，才能放置。

column1: Use a screw pump to move liquids upward from the elevation below the pump to the same elevation as the pump.
column2: 使用螺杆泵将下层的液体向上抽送到泵所在的高度层。

column1: Place the water wheel above flowing water to generate power for machines, such as the millstone or screw pump.
column2: 将水车建在流动的水上方，为机械石磨、螺杆泵等机械提供动力。

column1: Place the windmill aboveground to generate power for machines, such as the millstone or screw pump. Not all areas have strong winds.
column2: 将风车建在地表，为机械石磨、螺杆泵等机械提供动力。并非所有地区都有强风。

column1: Use the gear assembly to connect axles and machinery together. Gear assemblies can be disengaged temporarily by linking them to levers.
column2: 使用齿轮组连接传动轴和机械。将齿轮组连接到控制杆后，可以暂时断开传动。

column1: Horizontal axles transfer power on the same elevation. Horizontal axles can be east-west or north-south.
column2: 水平传动轴在同一高度层传递动力，可沿东西或南北方向放置。

column1: Vertical axles transfer power between two adjacent elevations.
column2: 垂直传动轴在相邻的两个高度层之间传递动力。

column1: Rollers move minecarts on tracks without the need for a citizen to push or guide the minecart.
column2: 滚动辊可让矿车沿轨道移动，无需居民推动或引导。

column1: A chain can be placed for use in the justice system or for the restraint of an animal.
column2: 可放置锁链，用于司法系统或拴住动物。

column1: Cages can be used to contain an animal, and metal cages can be used by the justice system. Glass cages can be filled with water and used as aquariums.
column2: 笼子可关押动物，金属笼也可用于司法系统。玻璃笼可以装水作为水族箱。

column1: Animal traps can be placed in the wild and baited with meat, plants, or gems, in order to catch small creatures.
column2: 可在野外放置动物陷阱，用肉、植物或宝石作诱饵，捕捉小型生物。

column1: Track stops are used in conjunction with the hauling menu. They can also be used to add friction to minecart tracks.
column2: 轨道站点配合搬运菜单使用，也可增加矿车轨道的摩擦力。

column1: Levers are used with machines, doors, floodgates, bridges, cages, and other structures to change their state.
column2: 控制杆可与机械、门、闸门、桥梁、笼子及其他建筑相连，用于改变其状态。

column1: Pressure plates, like levers, are used with machines, doors, floodgates, bridges, cages, and other structures to change their state. The trigger for pressure plates can be set by creature weight, fluid, or minecart passage.
column2: 压力板与控制杆类似，可与机械、门、闸门、桥梁、笼子及其他建筑相连，改变其状态。可设置按生物重量、液体或矿车经过来触发。

column1: Stone-fall traps drop a stone on intruders. Must be loaded with boulders.
column2: 落石陷阱会向入侵者投下石头。必须装填巨石。
